title: Sally's first train ride / It is repaired regularly.
subtitle: 萨莉的第一次乘火车旅行 / 它被定期修理

lead.question: 孩子当众说了一句大实话，大人为什么反而脸红？用英语讲这个趣事，句子主语常常不是「某人」，而是「事情本身」——这就要用被动语态。
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你带四岁的女儿第一次坐火车：She was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before. 注意这里出现了本课主角——被动语态：was invited（被邀请）、was dressed（穿着）、was amused / was embarrassed（感到有趣/尴尬）。英语不想说清「是谁做的」时，就用 be + 过去分词把动作承受者推上主语位。先试着把「房间定期通风」译成英语（The room is aired regularly.），再读萨莉和那位戴滑稽帽子的中年女士的故事。
goals: 掌握被动语态（1）：一般现在时 am/is/are + 过去分词，一般过去时 was/were + 过去分词
能用被动式表达情感：be amused / be embarrassed / be worried / be surprised
掌握复合形容词：four-year-old（year 用单数）、middle-aged
掌握短语 get on / take out / put away / make up / be dressed in
lead.summary: 第 141 课是一则叙事：上周作者四岁的女儿萨莉被邀请参加儿童聚会，作者带她乘火车去。萨莉兴奋极了，靠窗坐着对一切问个不停。一位中年女士上车坐到她对面，打开粉盒往脸上搽粉，说「为了把自己打扮漂亮」。萨莉盯着她看了半天，来了句「可是你仍然难看呀」——孩子觉得有趣，妈妈却尴尬得要命。第 142 课围绕被动语态操练：Someone airs it regularly. → It is aired regularly.。
lead.tips: ① 被动语态 = be + 过去分词，时态体现在 be 上：is aired（现在）/ was watered（过去）；② 表达情感的动词 amuse, embarrass, worry, surprise, interest, upset 常用被动式：She is embarrassed. 她感到尴尬；③ 复合形容词中名词用单数：a four-year-old girl（不是 years）；④ make up 指往脸上搽脂粉「化妆」，put away 是「放好、收起来」；⑤ be dressed in + 衣服 = 穿着……；opposite prep. 在……对面，sat opposite Sally 坐在萨莉对面。

questions.a: Because Sally told the lady, 'But you are still ugly.' — the child said out loud what adults would never say.
questions.aZh: 因为萨莉对那位女士说了「可是你仍然难看呀」——孩子把大人们绝不会说出口的话说了出来。
questions.hint: 听课文最后两句 Sally said / I was very embarrassed.

questions.a: Because she had never travelled on a train before.
questions.hint: 听 because 引导的原因从句。

questions.a: She was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
questions.aZh: 她穿着一件蓝色大衣，戴着一顶又大又滑稽的帽子。

questions.q: What did the lady do after the train had left the station?
questions.zh: 火车开出车站后，那位女士做了什么？
questions.a: She opened her handbag, took out her powder compact and began to make up her face.
questions.aZh: 她打开手提包，拿出粉盒，开始往脸上搽粉。
questions.hint: 注意 took out / began to make up 两个动作。

questions.q: Why do we say 'Sally was invited to a party' instead of 'Someone invited Sally to a party'?
questions.zh: 为什么说 Sally was invited to a party 而不说 Someone invited Sally to a party？
questions.a: In English the passive is used to avoid a vague subject like 'someone' and to put the focus on the person or thing the action happens to. Who invited her doesn't matter here.
questions.aZh: 英语用被动语态可以避免用 someone 这类含混的主语，并把重点放在动作的承受者上——这里「谁邀请的」并不重要，重要的是萨莉被邀请了。
questions.hint: 想想这句话里真正要说的信息是谁被邀请，还是谁发出邀请。

questions.q: Someone airs it regularly. → It is aired regularly. / Someone watered them. → They were watered this morning.
questions.zh: 第 142 课操练：Someone + 动词 + it/them → It/They + be + 过去分词（一般现在/一般过去被动）
questions.a: Someone sharpened it. It was sharpened this morning.
questions.aZh: 有人磨过它。它今天早上被磨过了。
questions.hint: 现在时 is/are + 过去分词；过去时 was/were + 过去分词。

examples.zh: 萨莉非常兴奋，因为她从未乘过火车。

lines.en: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
lines.zh: 上周，我四岁的女儿萨莉被邀请去参加一个儿童聚会。
lines.note: was invited 被动语态：一般过去时 was/were + 过去分词

lines.en: I decided to take her by train. Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
lines.zh: 我决定带她乘火车去。萨莉非常激动，因为她从未乘过火车。

lines.en: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw. Suddenly, a middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
lines.zh: 她靠车窗坐着，对她所看到的一切都要问个明白。突然，一位中年妇女上了火车，坐在萨莉的对面。
lines.note: get on the train 上火车；opposite Sally 在萨莉对面

lines.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
lines.zh: 萨莉没回答，却好奇地看着她。

lines.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat. After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact. She then began to make up her face.
lines.zh: 那位妇女穿着一件蓝色的大衣，戴着一顶大而滑稽的帽子。火车开出车站后，那位妇女打开了手提包，拿出了粉盒，然后她开始打扮起来。
lines.note: be dressed in 穿着；make up her face 往脸上搽脂粉

lines.speaker: LADY
lines.zh: 为了把自己打扮漂亮啊。
lines.note: 省略句，完整为 I am doing that to make myself beautiful.

lines.en: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
lines.zh: 她放好了粉盒，慈祥地微笑着。

lines.en: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
lines.zh: 萨莉感到很有趣，而我却很尴尬！
lines.note: amused/embarrassed 都是情感动词的被动式

drill.q: Someone + 动词 + it/them (+ regularly / this morning). → It is / They are + 过去分词. / It was / They were + 过去分词.
drill.zh: 有人（定期/今早）做了某事 → 某物被（定期/今早）做了某事（一般现在/一般过去时的被动语态）

slots.zh: 带去上学 — 今天早上

slots.en: meet them at the station — this morning（过去）
slots.zh: 在车站迎接 — 今天早上

answers: Someone airs it regularly. It is aired regularly.
Someone watered them. They were watered this morning.

make up her face 的意思是：

修饰人的感受用 -ed 形式 embarrassed；embarrassing 修饰事物本身。

grammar.title: 被动语态（1）：一般现在时与一般过去时
grammar.structure: am/is/are + 过去分词（现在）；was/were + 过去分词（过去）
grammar.definition: 被动句中主语是动作的承受者。英语常用被动语态避免以 someone 等含混的词作主语，或把重点放在事件本身。过去分词不一定指过去。
grammar.usage: 不想说或不必说「谁做的」时用被动。

examples.en: The room is aired regularly.
examples.zh: 这个房间定期通风。

examples.en: She was dressed in red.
examples.zh: 她身穿红色衣服。

grammar.title: 情感动词的被动式
grammar.structure: be + amused / embarrassed / worried / surprised / interested / upset
grammar.definition: 表达感情的动词（amuse, embarrass, worry, surprise, interest, upset 等）常用被动式表示「某人感到……」。
grammar.usage: 主语是人，用 be + 过去分词。

examples.en: She is embarrassed.
examples.zh: 她感到尴尬。

examples.en: They were worried.
examples.zh: 他们感到担忧。

grammar.title: 复合形容词
grammar.structure: 数词/名词 + 名词/过去分词，用连字符连接（名词用单数）
grammar.definition: 几个词用连字符连在一起构成复合形容词，作名词的定语：four-year-old（四岁的）、middle-aged（中年的）、hand-made（手工制作的）。复合词中的名词用单数形式。

examples.en: My four-year-old daughter, Sally.
examples.zh: 我四岁的女儿萨莉。（不用 four-years-old）

examples.en: A middle-aged lady.
examples.zh: 一位中年女士。

examples.zh: 突然，一位中年妇女上了火车。

examples.en: She then began to make up her face.

examples.zh: 那位妇女穿着一件蓝色大衣，戴着一顶大而滑稽的帽子。

examples.en: I decided to take her by train.
examples.zh: 我决定带她乘火车去。
